description_en: Retrieves the details of automated review results in real time
description_zh: 调用本接口获取智能审核结果详情。通过此接口可实时查询审核结果详情
name: GetMediaAuditResultDetail

parameters.help_en: The page number of the video content review results. Default value: 1. Maximum number of entries per page: 20
parameters.help_zh: 视频内容审核结果页码。默认值为1，每页最多返回20条记录
parameters.name: page_no

MediaAuditResultDetail.description_en: The details of the review results

List.description_en: The list of video review result details
List.description_zh: 视频审核结果详情列表

AdLabel.description_en:
The category of the ad review result. Valid values:
normal: Normal.
ad: Other ads.
politics: Political content in text.
porn: Pornographic content in text.
abuse: Abusive content in text.
terrorism: Terrorism content in text.
contraband: Contraband content in text.
spam: Other spam content in text.
npx: Psoriasis ads.
qrcode: QR code included.
programCode: Mini program code included
AdLabel.description_zh:
广告审核结果分类。取值：
normal：正常。
ad：其他广告。
politics：文字含涉政内容。
porn：文字含涉黄内容。
abuse：文字含辱骂内容。
terrorism：文字含暴恐内容。
contraband：文字含违禁内容。
spam：文字含其他垃圾内容。
npx：牛皮癣广告。
qrcode：含二维码。
programCode：含小程序码

AdScore.description_en: The hit score of the video snapshot for the ad review result. Valid values: `[0-100]`. The value is accurate to 10 decimal places. The hit score indicates the probability that the snapshot matches the corresponding label. A higher score indicates higher accuracy
AdScore.description_zh: 广告审核结果的视频截图的命中分数。取值为：`[0-100]`，精度小数点后10位。命中结果为对应分类Label的概率，值越高则命中准确性越高

LiveLabel.description_en:
The category of the undesirable scene review result. Valid values:
normal: Normal.
meaningless: No content in the image, such as a black or white screen.
PIP: Picture-in-Picture (PiP).
smoking: Smoking.
drivelive: Live streaming in a car
LiveLabel.description_zh:
不良场景审核结果分类。取值：
normal：正常。
meaningless：图片中无内容（例如黑屏、白屏）。
PIP：画中画。
smoking：吸烟。
drivelive：车内直播
